title: Salts of boronium (+3) ions with unprecedented hydrolytic stability. Design, synthesis, single-crystal X-ray structures, electrochemistry, and thermophysical properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19947-19953
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02301G, Paper
Open Access

Margaret E. Crowley, Christopher D. Stachurski, James H. Davis, Matthias Zeller, Gabriel A. Merchant, E. A. Salter, A. Wierzbicki, Richard A. O'Brien, Paul C. Trulove, David P. Durkin
Boron trications are rare and tend to be unstable, especially in water. We show herein that they can be made highly water-stable by using strongly electron-donating 4-(dialkylamino)pyridine ligands to support the boron centre.
